This function is enabled by defining the compile-time macro, 'DO_ATTACH_LOOP_BODIES'.

A normalization pass over the AST ensures that metrics assigned to multiple nodes at the same depth in the AST sum to the original raw metric value. For example, suppose the HPCToolkit reports 100 cycles for a source line consisting four distinct statements:
Another example is loop headers for (i=0;i<100; i++)
The MetricAttachTraversal will assign 100 to each of the statements. This pass will assign each statement the value of 25, so the total sums to the original metric value of 100.
